facts.fact: 楼上一声闷响把 Kate 惊醒；她昨晚太累忘了设闹钟，手机显示已是上午 9:30。
facts.anchor: A thud from somewhere above awoke her in confusion

facts.fact: Smith 发来短信：假定她昨晚安全到家，他自己正去 Otley Road，让她起床后回电。
facts.anchor: Assume you got back safe last night? I’m heading to Otley Road. Call me when you’re up.

facts.fact: Kate 与 Smith 在电话里第一次争吵：她指责他没等她，他回"累了"，她反问他"累了？我开车去了威尔士又回来"。
facts.anchor: I drove to Wales and back.

facts.fact: Kate 查 Olivia 案进展：Elliot 尚未被正式起诉，警方须在傍晚前决定起诉、释放或再申请延长三天；一旦起诉她的追查机会就没了。
facts.anchor: No charge had yet been brought against Elliot.

facts.fact: Kate 打开 Instagram，调出 Olivia 室友 Abi 的账号"The Real Abs"，从蛋糕、自拍等帖子里找线索。
facts.anchor: She opened Instagram and brought up the account of Olivia’s flatmate Abi, The Real Abs.

facts.fact: 一张夜出合照的发布日期，与 Elliot 自称在 Olivia 房间、用她电脑发邮件的日期吻合。
facts.anchor: It matched the date on which Elliot had placed himself in Olivia’s room

facts.fact: Elliot 的室友猜测警方逮捕他是因为他的指纹遍布 Olivia 的电脑。
facts.anchor: I guess his fingerprints were all over her computer.

facts.fact: 室友否认 Elliot 与 Olivia 有恋情，说他一直喜欢的是她的室友 Millie，从去年就盯上了。
facts.anchor: He’s well keen on her flatmate, Millie.
